name: qfd_cb16c_es182

pin_regs.reason: CB16c-COLL: this slice IS one flip-flop per bit between its d and q pins (the face pin register moved out of the body); a flow pin register would add a second stage the face calendar does not price

structural_change: CB16c-COLL 10-22: collective face edge register slice qfd_coll_eslice182 (182 b, one stage d->q, ck N), the regional sub-tile of qfd_coll_face_cx: 6 instances per face on their own clock entries (W tx_data / rx_data: 182 b on cal_ck_t* / rx_rck_r*; E phy_tx / phy_rx: 199 b on codec0p_t* / codec0p_r*), hardened once. Outline = one third of the face bus (145.8 um of pins at the face pin pitch); recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die.

job.purpose: CB16c-COLL: collective face edge slice qfd_coll_eslice182 (ALT regional split of the COLLIO faces)
